audit_items.proof_trace: Production builds lack synchronization around params.BeaconConfig() (config_utils_prod.go:10-11 reads configs.active without locks, while OverrideBeaconConfig at line 20 writes it unsynchronized). This is a data race: if OverrideBeaconConfig() executes concurrently during UpgradeToFulu(), line 119 could read a partially-written or wrong FuluForkVersion, violating the post-condition and potentially causing consensus failure.
audit_items.attack_scenario: If OverrideBeaconConfig() is called concurrently with UpgradeToFulu() during fork activation (e.g., via test harness, debug endpoint, or initialization race), the data race on configs.active allows wrong fork version to be committed to state, causing consensus divergence.
